comments: Tommy will have to eat humble pie next week after awarding the £10 record token to someone with the wrong answer to last week’s Friday Night Connection. The answer is given as Rock because “Indian Sunset” is on “Rock Of The Westies”, shame it’s actually on “Madman Across the Water”
